http/sse#

Server-sent events (HTML Living Standard §9.2): text/event-stream.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let channel is Channel<ServerEvent> = Channel(16);
Response(status: Status.ok, headers: EventStreamHeaders().headers(), body: EventBody(channel.receiving()));
let sending = channel.sending();
await sending.send(ServerEvent(data: "tick"));
await sending.send(ServerEvent(data: "{}", event: "update", identifier: "42", retry: Duration(seconds: 3.rat())));

let events = ServerEvents(response.reading());
let event = await events.event();                  // EventStreamEnded at the end
event::Event::data;

Description#

Server-sent events (HTML Living Standard §9.2): text/event-stream.

The writer sends what the channel receives until it closes. The reader splits on any line ending, joins data lines, and remembers the last id for reconnection.
